correctness.rationale: Greedy arch number equals subsequence-universality index. For a prefix with r<k complete arches and s seen distinct symbols in current arch, exact minimum completion length is q(k-r)-s by arch disjointness and a construction. Slack0 permits only unseen letters, others permit any. Sorted linked-list and reversible updates allow constant-time next-feasible-child, and the path-to-path DFS bound O(n)+O(q floor(n/q))=O(n) includes arch list allocation and explicit output. Exhaustive direct comparisons checked q=1..4,n=0..7,k=0..3 (128 combinations,38984 words) plus 4 long/large-alphabet tests. Boundary n<kq and k=0 included.
